entries.title: Offline app & bulletin board
entries.body: You can install Codex Arcane as an app and optionally save data for offline use. This board lists site changes; use Update when a new version is available.

entries.title: Safer links
entries.body: Monster, map, and item links only open when that content exists in your downloaded data (correct type).

entries.title: Used For sections
entries.body: Upgrade Into / Crafting labels are clearer; linked items stay clickable when present.
